results.question: How many vacation days do new employees get?
results.answer: New employees receive 15 vacation days per year.
contexts:
Acme Robotics Employee Handbook: General Policies | Time Off Policy:
New employees receive 15 vacation days per year. After 3 years of continuous service, this increases to 20 days per year. Up to 5 unused vacation days may be carried over into the next calendar year; any days above 5 are forfeited on December 31. The company is officially closed between December 25 and January 1. These closure days do not count against an employee's accrued vacation balance.

Acme Robotics Employee Handbook: General Policies | Sick Leave:
Every employee receives 10 paid sick days per year, separate from vacation. Sick days do not carry over. A doctor's note is required only if an employee is out for more than 3 consecutive days.

Acme Robotics Employee Handbook: General Policies | Public Holidays:
The company observes 9 paid public holidays: New Year's Day, Martin Luther King Jr. Day, Memorial Day, Juneteenth, Independence Day, Labor Day, Thanksgiving Day, the day after Thanksgiving, and Christmas Day.

Acme Robotics Employee Handbook: Compensation and Performance | Promotions:
Promotion decisions are made once per year, effective April 1. An employee must have spent at least 12 months in their current level and have received a rating of 4 or higher in the most recent December review.

correctness.reason: The reference states that new employees get 15 vacation days per year. The candidate states, "New employees receive 15 vacation days per year." This matches the key fact exactly.

Acme Robotics Employee Handbook: Compensation and Performance | Promotions:
Promotion decisions are made once per year, effective April 1. An employee must have spent at least 12 months in their current level and have received a rating of 4 or higher in the most recent December review.

Only employees who have completed the Robot Cell Safety course may enter an active robot cell. The course must be renewed every 12 months. Visitors must be escorted at all times and may not enter an active robot cell under any circumstances.

Acme Robotics Employee Handbook: Health and Safety | Emergency Stop and Lockout:
Every robot cell has a red emergency stop button. Anyone who sees a dangerous situation must press it immediately without waiting for permission. Before performing maintenance on a robot, the technician must apply a personal lockout/tagout lock; no one else may remove it.

Acme Robotics Employee Handbook: Security and AI Usage | Incident Reporting:
Any suspected security incident must be reported to security@acmerobotics.example within one hour. Employees who report promptly in good faith will not be disciplined for honest mistakes.

Acme Robotics Employee Handbook: Health and Safety | Protective Equipment:
Safety glasses are required in all lab areas. Steel-toed shoes are required whenever heavy robotic arms, rated above 20 kg payload, are being moved or installed. Hearing protection is required in the Pittsburgh machining area.
